tokens.name: palette-black
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Black (kuro-iro). Aliased by bg-000. Never use raw in components; use the role tokens.

tokens.name: palette-vandyke-brown
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Vandyke Brown (kogecha-iro). Base page colour of the brand. Aliased by bg-300; also gradient stops.

tokens.name: palette-raw-sienna
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Raw Sienna (hiwada-iro), lifted from the photographed #b5612a for legibility on dark grounds. Base page colour; empty-state orb, Ask AI glow stop. As text: 5.3:1 on bg-000, 5.0:1 on bg-100, 4.6:1 on bg-200, 4.7:1 on inset-100. Not text on bg-300 or inset-200 (4.1:1); there, only 24px+.

tokens.name: palette-deep-indigo
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Deep Indigo (kon-iro). Base page colour. Aliased by inset-200: the cool counterweight for version-level surfaces.

tokens.name: palette-english-red
tokens.usage: Source swatch: English Red (kaba-iro). Aliased by danger. Fill only, with ink on top.

tokens.name: palette-ivory-buff
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Ivory Buff (shiracha). Aliased by ink-2.

tokens.name: palette-vistoris-lake
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Vistoris Lake (kurikawa-iro). Gradient stop and mid-tone; never text.

tokens.name: palette-violet-carmine
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Violet Carmine (kuwazome-iro). Gradient stop for the Ask AI panel wash (option B); never text.

tokens.name: palette-laelia-pink
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Laelia Pink (benifuji). Sparingly: changed-value marker line, one stop of the Ask AI hover glow.

tokens.name: palette-pinkish-cinnamon
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Pinkish Cinnamon (tonoko-iro). Aliased by accent.

tokens.name: palette-burnt-sienna
tokens.usage: Source swatch: Burnt Sienna (kuriume). Aliased by danger-hover.

tokens.name: palette-soft-green
tokens.usage: Source swatch: soft green (byakuroku, approx.). Aliased by success. Sparingly: success, one stop of the Ask AI hover glow.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page background. The ground everything sits on; carries the grain overlay.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Raised surface: recipe cards, compact navbar, menus.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Hover state of bg-100 surfaces; secondary button hover fill.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Selected / pressed surfaces, tag fills, the strongest warm surface. ink-3 is the lightest text allowed here (4.95:1).

tokens.name: inset-100
tokens.usage: Tinted inset panel background (Version History, Ask AI panel). Cool indigo counterpoint to the brown page.

tokens.name: inset-200
tokens.usage: Version-level input fill, rows inside inset-100 panels, and the Ask AI button's static fill (ink on it 11.7:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headlines, body, values. 15.7:1 on bg-000, 11.7:1 on bg-300, 13.4:1 on inset-100.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: lead paragraphs, card meta, field labels. 10.6:1 on bg-000, 7.9:1 on bg-300 and inset-200.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: technical labels, timestamps, 'now X' lines, placeholders. 6.5:1 on bg-000, 4.95:1 on bg-300 and inset-200 (lowest allowed grounds).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text only (exempt from contrast). Always pair a disabled control with a readable note in ink-3.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (primary button). 8.5:1 on accent.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one warm accent: primary button fill, links, active nav item, selection. 8.7:1 on bg-000, 6.5:1 on bg-300.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill and link hover. on-accent on it 10.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill. on-accent on it 6.4:1.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Accent for graphics (gradient stops, progress) and secondary warm text on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200 and inset-100 (4.6:1+). Not for small text on bg-300 or inset-200.

tokens.name: line-grid
tokens.usage: Thin decorative grid lines across the page (editorial grid). Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card outlines, section rules, navbar bottom rule.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons on warm surfaces. 4.3:1 on bg-000, 3.3:1 on bg-300.

tokens.name: line-control-cool
tokens.usage: Border of version-level inputs on inset-100 / inset-200. 3.5:1 on inset-100, 3.1:1 on inset-200.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element. 11.7:1+ on every surface; reads on the accent fill via the offset gap.

tokens.name: changed
tokens.usage: Text of an old value that differs from the current recipe. 8.6:1 on bg-000, 7.6:1 on inset-100. Always with a strike or marker and a 'now X' line.

tokens.name: changed-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint behind a changed value. changed text on it: 6.2:1+.

tokens.name: changed-line
tokens.usage: 2px underline / marker of a changed value.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and the error icon/label. 8.2:1 on bg-000, 6.3:1 on bg-300.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of an error message block. error on it: 7.4:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger (delete) button fill. ink on it: 5.5:1.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Danger button hover fill (darkens). ink on it: 7.1:1.

tokens.name: danger-press
tokens.usage: Danger button pressed fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text ('Saved', 'Brew logged') with a word, never colour alone. 9.3:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a success notice.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per page at most: landing hero, recipe title on its own page. Uppercase. In CSS use clamp(64px, 12vw, 160px).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles (My Recipes, Brew Log). Uppercase. clamp(52px, 8vw, 112px).

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headings on long pages. Uppercase. clamp(40px, 5.5vw, 72px).

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Recipe card title on large cards, panel titles. Uppercase or Title Case.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sub-section headings, card titles in dense grids, the navbar wordmark (compact).

styles.name: accent-xl
styles.usage: Wide extended italic (Archivo at font-stretch 125%, set by the bi-accent class). Version numbers, one emphasised word in a headline. Never a full sentence.

styles.name: accent-md
styles.usage: Inline accent word next to display text, version badge on cards. Extended via bi-accent.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A journal for the cups you keep coming back to.
styles.usage: Large calm text: intros, About, empty states. Max 28ch-36ch per line.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Bloom for 45 seconds, then pour in three slow circles.
styles.usage: Recipe method steps, brew notes, recipe-level input values.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, buttons (weight 500), form help text. Max 68ch.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, 'now X' lines, error messages.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Measured values in data fields and version-level inputs. Tabular numbers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small technical labels: field labels, card meta, nav items. Uppercase.

styles.name: label-xs
styles.usage: Corner annotations, grid-line captions, timestamps. Uppercase. Smallest size allowed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-value gap inside a data field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding, 'now X' line offset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding, gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, desktop grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups, inset panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between card rows on large grids.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero top/bottom breathing room. Empty space is part of the look.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Grid lines, full-bleed images, colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, data tags, the changed-value highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs (version-level), menus, error message blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Recipe cards, tinted inset panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero image frames, large feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All buttons, the compact navbar, badges.

shadow.note: Dark and flat: separation comes from surfaces and hairlines, not shadows. Only floating layers get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for cards, buttons, panels.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: 1px top highlight on raised surfaces (cards, compact navbar) so they catch light on the dark page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, select dropdowns, the compact navbar while scrolling.

duration.note: Motion durations. All collapse to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion (bundle.css).

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Pressed states, checkbox ticks.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes, focus ring appearance.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Opening an inline form, navbar large-to-compact.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Expanding / collapsing panels (Version History, Ask AI).

tokens.name: duration-delete
tokens.usage: Deleting an item: fade + collapse height.

tokens.name: duration-scroll
tokens.usage: Smooth scroll to an anchor (JS-driven). CSS scroll-behavior: smooth only when motion is allowed.

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: One full turn of the Ask AI border glow while hovered. Off under reduced motion (the glow stays, static).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for colour and layout changes.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things appearing: forms opening, panels expanding. Long calm tail.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: deleting items, closing panels.

tokens.name: ease-scroll
tokens.usage: Smooth scroll (JS) and navbar shrink.

tokens.name: layout-max
tokens.usage: Max page width; grid lines run to this edge.

tokens.name: layout-content
tokens.usage: Main content column width.

tokens.name: layout-measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body text.

tokens.name: layout-columns
tokens.usage: Desktop grid columns (4 on mobile, 8 on tablet).

tokens.name: nav-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large navbar at page top.

tokens.name: nav-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact navbar after scroll.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards and panels.
